composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Illustrate Heiji Hattori with his familiar darker complexion, short black hair, and easy smile. His cap is held low against his chest rather than shading his eyes, and he wears a modest teal casual jacket over a plain shirt. Turn the shoulders slightly while keeping the face forward. Use a detailed animation finish with restrained warm cheek light, clean hair shapes, and carefully drawn fingers around the cap edge. The background is a broad pale teal field with one darker vertical plane. Keep both eyes clear and the expression friendly, avoiding dramatic staging or props beyond the cap. Give both visible irises clear red patterns and bright catchlights. Behind the shoulders only, add two separate abstract black flame-shaped light ornaments for Amaterasu; they touch and burn nothing. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
